headline: Colonial Standard Rises at Linn Mercy; Mooring County Aflame
war_summary: The Colonial ledger has lengthened at Linn Mercy, where ten works now stand to their name against a single unclaimed ruin and no Warden flag, one more than at the last edition. Weathered Expanse has shifted likewise, the Colonials taking a third work there to leave four Warden and two unclaimed; its guns still speak, ten actions in six hours and an exchange logged after midnight. The sharpest turn is at Mooring County, where this office last reported the Wardens holding nine works; the count now reads six Warden, five Colonial and one unclaimed, with seven actions in the past two hours and the war's freshest exchange stamped at this packet's cutoff. Callum's Cape remains the busiest field of the day at forty-five actions, though only two have fallen in six hours, and the lines hold at four Colonial works to three Warden. Marban Hollow stands three apiece with two unclaimed. Lykos Isle and Stlican Shelf have stirred briefly; Stonecradle, Nevish Line and Godcrofts are quiet, their last reports hours old.
